engine: The bare hero LAYER that breathes — a fixed clipping FRAME holding ONE full-bleed render (/

measured_teardown.move: set(p) is a PURE function of progress: render transform scale = scaleFrom + p*(scaleTo - scaleFrom) (default 1.0 -> 1.12), optional translateY drift = (p - 0.5)*2*drift. No side effects beyond transform on the render; reversible. By DEFAULT the layer is host-driven: the host hero's pin/scrub calls set(p). Pass selfTrigger:true to own a plain (NOT pinned) ScrollTrigger over its own pass (start 'top bottom', end 'bottom top'). The frame is overflow:hidden so the zoom is clipped to the frame, not a full-bleed grow.
measured_teardown.cited: Ever / crownd hero renders: a full-bleed exterior render that gently pushes in as the hero scrolls, the wordmark/title held over it; the breathing background was only ever a concept-reference in teardowns, never a standalone brick.

scaleFrom.what: render scale at p=0 (host's pin start / section enters).

scaleTo.what: render scale at p=1 (host's pin end / section leaves). The frame clips the overflow.

originY.what: transform-origin Y of the render (e.g. '0%' to push toward the horizon, '50%' centered, '100%' toward the foreground).

drift.what: optional vertical parallax of the render across the pass (+/- drift); 0 = pure scale.

ease.what: scrub ease (linear so the scale tracks scroll 1:1). The host/scrub owns the curve; set(p) itself is linear in p.

selfTrigger.what: false = host-driven (host calls set(p)); true = own a plain NON-pinned ScrollTrigger over the layer's natural pass.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start when selfTrigger (frame top hits viewport bottom).

end.what: ScrollTrigger end when selfTrigger (frame bottom hits viewport top).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false = the page/host drives a shared Lenis (default, since this is a layer).

entry: RenderScrollScale.create(target, opts) -> { set(p), trigger, lenis, refresh(), destroy }. target = .rss-frame > img.rss-render (or video.rss-render). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the scale. owns_pin false.
law: transform scale + translateY (the render) + overflow clip (the frame) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO canvas drawImage / NO video.currentTime scrub; NO animating width/height/top/left/margin; NO WebGL. reduced-motion or <=820px -> static (render at scaleFrom). DECODE-GUARD: the render is force-decoded (img.decode()) before __LAB_OK__ so a hidden never black-flickers on first paint. owns_pin false (a layer; it does NOT pin — the host pin OR a plain selfTrigger drives it). GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for selfTrigger; set(p) works standalone.
gate_mode: host-driven scrub OR self scrub (NOT pinned). Verify: the render scale ramps scaleFrom -> scaleTo across progress; the FRAME clips it (overflow hidden — the render grows but the frame box doesn't); set(p) is pure and reversible (set(0.5) then set(0) returns exactly). Distinct from scroll-zoom-image-pair (no copy, no L/R layout here). Smoothness via the scroll path.
proven: lab: ONE QUADRO render (renders/day-front.webp) in a 100vh .rss-frame, scrubbed by a simple (non-pinned) ScrollTrigger. Measured live: scale 1.0 -> 1.03 -> 1.06 -> 1.09 -> 1.12 across p (linear); frame overflow = hidden (clip confirmed); set(0.5)->set(0) reverses to scale(1.0000) exactly (PURE). Decode-guard: img.decode() resolved before reveal (no black flicker). Probe (scroll-scrub): zero console errors, __LAB_OK__ true.
